newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-UCHE AND OKOCHA APPLY TO BECOME TURKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UCHE AND OKOCHA APPLY TO BECOME TURKS.

text.p: Nigerian footballers Uche Okechukwu and Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha who play for Istanbul club Fenerbahce have made official applications to become Turkish citizens, Anatolian new agency said on Tuesday.
The move, originally announced at the end of October, would allow Fenerbahce to bypass Turkish Football Federation rules which allow clubs to field only three foreign players at one time.
The pair, who have played key roles in Fenerbahce's European Champions League campaign, have chosen the new names Muhammet Okocha and Rahim Uche, Anatolian said.
